key_components_to_build.name: Header & Nav Bar
key_components_to_build.description: Sticky dark glass navbar (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050B14]/80`) with ATLANTIS crest, links for Projects, Portfolio, About, RERA Verification, Contact, Theme Toggle, and VIP Enquiry CTA button.

key_components_to_build.name: Cinematic Hero & 3D Coverflow Showcase
key_components_to_build.description: Hero section with subtle background motion overlay, stats counter (e.g. $2.4B Delivered Portfolio, 18+ Architectural Awards, 99.4% On-time Completion, 12 Premium Landmarks), Quick Search bar (City, Property Type, BHK, Budget), and interactive 3D Coverflow card carousel.

key_components_to_build.name: Featured Projects & Status Filter
key_components_to_build.description: Filter tabs (All, Ongoing, Delivered, Upcoming) showing luxury project cards with status badges, RERA registration numbers, starting price tag, location, BHK spec, and quick 'Explore Landmark' button.

key_components_to_build.name: Category Tiles & Living Amenities
key_components_to_build.description: Editorial grid highlighting Ultra-Luxury Residential Villas, High-Rise Penthouses, Commercial Headquarters, and Prime Waterfront Masterplans with interactive hover elevation effect.

key_components_to_build.name: Project Detail View Page
key_components_to_build.description: Complete detail view with sticky sub-nav bar (Overview, 3D Showcase, Gallery, Amenities, Specifications, Floor Plans, Location, RERA, Enquire), high-resolution lightbox gallery, interactive interactive floor plan switcher (2BHK, 3BHK, Sky Penthouse), Price matrix table with cost breakdown calculator, direct PDF Brochure download modal, and direct VIP Private Tour booking form.

key_components_to_build.name: Company History & Milestones Timeline
key_components_to_build.description: Interactive timeline detailing ATLANTIS's legacy since 2008, architect collaborations (Foster & Partners style), sustainability certifications (LEED Platinum), and delivered sq. ft. metrics.

key_components_to_build.name: Admin Panel & CRM Lead Pipeline
key_components_to_build.description: Full Admin CMS & CRM Dashboard accessible at `/admin`. Includes Kanban lead management board (New Lead, Site Visit Scheduled, Negotiation, Contract Sent, Closed Won), Lead details drawer, Project CRUD editor with status toggle, price updater, and Recharts performance analytics.

key_components_to_build.name: Persistent Floating Tools & AI Concierge
key_components_to_build.description: WhatsApp VIP Direct Chat float button and 'ATLANTIS AI Luxury Concierge' chatbot drawer supporting instant queries on unit availability, pricing, site visit scheduling, and brochure requests.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratios: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large display gold titles over deep navy backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_navigation: Full focus ring outline `focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#050B14]` on all interactive elements.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: Every button, input, tab, project card, filter, modal trigger, and data item MUST contain a unique, kebab-case `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject Google Fonts stylesheet for 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' into public/index.html or top of index.css.
Ensure dark theme is active by default with high-contrast golden accent buttons and editorial typography.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance reveals on project cards, stats counters, and filter transitions.
Build standard React JS components (using `.js` / `.jsx` extension as defined in the frontend directory).
Implement persistent floating elements: WhatsApp floating CTA and AI Concierge Chatbot drawer.
Implement complete state management for filters (status, category, city, BHK, price) with live search updates.

Provide a realistic mock backend API endpoint setup in FastAPI (`/api/projects`, `/api/leads`, `/api/stats`, `/api/chat`) and synchronized frontend state with mock fallback data so the platform is fully responsive and interactive without missing dependencies.
